label: rare early-step conjunction (input j at last copy step of L=4; <DEL>/d/3 at steps 3-7)
explanation: Extremely sparse (0.0056% of steps) and weak (max 0.21). It only fires at steps 3-7, mostly in short sequences (L=3-5). The input token is usually j, d, <DEL> or 3, often right after h or 0. The cleanest piece is input j at step 7 of L=4 sequences, i.e. the last copy step, e.g. x y j j <DEL> x y [j]. That piece covers about 25% of activations at 4% precision. Every broad description (step window plus token set) reaches high recall but precision stays below 0.2%, so no coherent predicate was found. It never fires at steps 0-2 or after step 9, and never on wrong-copy rows.
